description: This file defines an abstract base class for unit tests related to length restrictions in entity identifiers within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides utility methods to generate strings of specific lengths for testing boundary conditions.

classes.name: LengthRestrictionTestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for tests concerning length restrictions on identifiers, providing string generation utilities for boundary testing.

methods.name: generateStringExceedingMaxLength
methods.description: Generates a string exceeding the maximum allowed length by one character, with optional prefix.

methods.name: generateStringWithMaxLength
methods.description: Generates a string exactly at the maximum allowed length, with optional prefix.

methods.name: generateStringWithLength
methods.description: Generates a string of specified length, optionally prefixed by a given string.
